chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Estonia.
Estonia is a small country in Northern Europe.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Where is Estonia?
Estonia is in Northern Europe.
It is part of the Baltic region.
It is next to Latvia, Russia and the Baltic Sea.
It is very close to Finland.
You can take a boat from Estonia to Finland.
Estonia is a small country, but it is full of forests, lakes and islands.
What is the capital city of Estonia?
The capital city is Tallinn.
Tallinn is a beautiful old city.
It is next to the sea.
It has old buildings, small streets and a big city wall.
Many tourists visit Tallinn.
They love the old town, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
How many people live in Estonia?
About 1.3 million people live in Estonia.
It is not a big country.
Most people live in cities like Tallinn, Tartu and Narva.
There are also many small towns and villages.
Much of Estonia is quiet and full of nature.
What language do people speak in Estonia?
People speak Estonian.
Estonian is the official language.
It is not like English, German or Russian.
It is closer to Finnish.
Some people also speak Russian or English, especially young people and in big cities.
English is taught in schools.
What is the weather like in Estonia?
Estonia has four seasons.
Spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Winters are cold and snowy.
People wear coats, hats and boots.
Lakes can freeze and the days are short.
Summers are mild and pleasant.
The weather is not very hot.
The days are long and people enjoy the sun.
Spring and autumn are cool and windy.
In autumn the trees turn yellow, red and orange.
What does Estonia look like?
Estonia has many forests, lakes and islands.
Over half of the country is covered by forest.
There are many quiet and peaceful places.
There are more than 2,000 islands in Estonia.
Some are very small and some have small towns.
Estonia also has bogs and swamps, which are special wetlands.
People like to walk on wooden paths in the bogs.
What animals live in Estonia?
Estonia has many wild animals.
You can see deer, foxes, wolves and lynxes.
In the forests, you may also see wild boars and brown bears.
There are also many birds, especially in spring and summer.
Estonia is a great place for bird watching.
What do people eat in Estonia?
Estonian food is simple and tasty.
People eat potatoes, meat, fish and bread.
They also eat cabbage, carrots and mushrooms.
One traditional food is black bread made from rye.
It is eaten with butter, cheese or soup.
Fish is also popular, especially herring and smoked fish.
In winter, people eat warm foods like stews and soups.
In summer, they enjoy fresh berries and ice cream.
What is life like in Estonia?
Life in Estonia is peaceful and quiet.
People enjoy nature and spend time outdoors.
They go walking, skiing or swimming in lakes.
Estonians also love saunas.
A sauna is a small hot room where people relax and sweat.
Many homes in Estonia have their own sauna.
Estonia is also a very digital country.
People use the internet for almost everything.
School, work and even voting.
It is one of the most online countries in the world.
Some fun facts about Estonia.
Estonia became independent in 1991 after the Soviet Union ended.
The flag has three colors, blue, black and white.
Estonia is part of the European Union and uses the Euro.
Estonians love singing.
They have big song festivals with thousands of people.
Estonia was the first country to offer online voting in a national election.
Now you know many things about Estonia.
You know where it is, what language people speak and what the weather is like.
You know about the forests, animals, food and culture.
Good job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emily.
